title: HealICON: spectral and wave analysis of ICON output on the HEALPix grid
description:
HealICON is a command-line tool for wave and tidal analysis of global atmospheric simulations. It uses HEALPix as the base grid for interpolation, providing an equal-area environment for mapping tidal harmonics and gravity-wave spectra across the globe.

This release is the version used for the global tidal decomposition reported in Morfa et al., Whole-atmosphere modeling with regional refinement: strengths and drawbacks assessed with observations from the VortEx campaign, Journal of Advances in Modeling Earth Systems. The tidal analysis follows Yamazaki (2023).
